title: Fraction bound against ligand concentration
summary: Change the dissociation constant and say where the binding curve goes: which way the fraction bound moves, how far, and what number it lands on.

spec.why: Kd is the ligand concentration at which half the protein is bound, so with Kd now {Kd} (it was {Kd0}) the curve is half-way up at {half}, and at {at} the fraction bound goes from {y0} to {y1}.
spec.note: Assumes the protein is much scarcer than the ligand, so free ligand is about the same as total ligand.
